Recipe: Juicy Pour Immersion (Lume)
Logic: mixing 2 different temperatures, creating more clarity and higher juiciness. Tends to compromise on intensity and body.

Dosage: 15g beans, 190g water total.
Grinder: Mahlkönig EK, grind size 9.2.
Water: both 90°C and 70°C.
Brewer: Hario Switch (hot filter recipe), Mola coffee filter paper.

Steps:
1. Pour 45g as a bloom with 90°C water, switch OPEN. At the 30s mark, close switch.
2. Pour 50g of 90°C water with strong agitation, and immediately pour 50g of 70°C water with a straight pour. Let it immerse until the 1:45 mark.
3. Open switch and let it flow out until 2:10.
4. Afterwards, pour the remaining 45g using 90°C water and let it draw down.
5. Total brew time should not exceed 3:10.
